title: Initial Configuration of the Constructed Oracle Machine
statement: Let $F$ be a finite-state binary Turing machine and let $x$ be a Boolean word. The initial configuration of the oracle machine constructed from $F$ on input $x$ is the capture image of $F$'s initial configuration, using the inclusion of $F$'s states into the enlarged state set, the query state as the return state, and empty prefix and output words.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a finite-state binary Turing machine
